purpose: Interactive Fiction Weaver draft about an AU claimshare default cascade at Pallas Service Ring Kappa. Tonal mode: dry workplace comedy with domestic warmth under administrative dread.

local_awareness_summary.text: Miri is a low-status ramp settlement clerk at Kappa's spoke-side shift gate. She can allocate local stores, authenticate work and custody, inspect notices, print records, and speak over the local work channel.
Miri cannot create cash, renew the operating certificate, change insurer or freight terms, import the withheld actuator, command Kara, or consent on behalf of the crews.
Miri sees Oru's pump state, Sef's offered household book, the queue, the lease and status notices, the shift clock, and Kara's arrival route; private motives remain unavailable.

frame_controls.text: Playable perspective remains local to Miri's kiosk, authority, debt exposure, visible records, and sightlines inside Service Ring Kappa.
The scene establishes an ordinary claimshare queue, cartridge replacement, household arithmetic, and shift preparation before the lease default cascades.

authority_boundaries.text: Miri owns local work authentication and custody decisions only. Kara owns the ramp order; crews own bodily refusal; external counterparties own their lease, certificate, coverage, and freight terms.
The household book can move local goods and time but cannot settle AU debt, import the actuator, or restore certification.

object_custody.text: The sealed oxygenation cartridge begins in local-store custody, can enter Oru's bodily support through Miri's release, and never becomes evidence that Oru consented to production.
The stamped lease receipt and printed queue copies preserve causal order only when independently held; the ramp screen remains a separate owner-controlled record.

required_semantics.text: One lease default must visibly alter supplier diagnostics, replacement custody, certification, coverage, freight terms, and claimshare access before labor refusal occurs.
Every preparation and freeze-response choice must change a later callback, ending gate, visual modifier, material margin, or evidence state.
The mutual-aid route must preserve concrete bodies and necessities without being narrated as systemic victory.

forbidden_resolutions.text: Do not treat claimshares as equity, a portable universal currency, or ownership of the ramp.
Do not merge BioElevate uplift workers and VitaForge BioDrone Standard workers into one supplier category.
Do not let a clerk's record, a household book, or worker solidarity repair an absent imported assembly by moral force.

branch_and_fold_plan.summary: Four ordinary queue choices fold into the lease default; four freeze responses fold into Kara's arrival; three final commitments select six state-gated endings.

branches.actor_intent: Reserve body support before general settlement order consumes the local stock.
state_basis: Miri owns local-store custody and can see Oru's pump whistle.
reviewed_consequences: Raises body_margin, sets cartridge_reserved, spends queue time, and increases supervisor pressure; later folds and production or mutual-aid endings read the body state.

branches.actor_intent: Preserve the physical-maintenance and payment states before the supplier changes access.
state_basis: The kiosk exposes local inspection, lease receipt, and supplier service panes.
reviewed_consequences: Sets lease_receipt_checked, raises default_evidence, and spends queue time; the default and refusal endings read preserved causal order.

branches.actor_intent: Reconcile local mutual obligations without marking corporate debt paid.
state_basis: Sef offers a grease-marked book covering three households.
reviewed_consequences: Sets mutual_book_live, raises worker_cohesion and claims_custody, and spends time; later scene and endings read the alternate account.

branches.actor_intent: Preserve certificate time by accepting ramp priority order.
state_basis: Miri can clear the morning queue in screen order.
reviewed_consequences: Raises queue_minutes and certificate_margin while reducing supervisor pressure; leaves body support and household custody weaker.

branches.actor_intent: Move cartridge and clinic stock into bodily use before the freeze reaches local stores.
state_basis: Miri has one local action before Kara arrives.
reviewed_consequences: Raises body_margin, sets cartridge_reserved, increases supervisor pressure, and spends time; Oru's later pump state and two ending families read it.

branches.actor_intent: Move the frozen queue into several witnessed household copies.
state_basis: The printer can produce local paper even after claim settlement freezes.
reviewed_consequences: Raises claims_custody and worker_cohesion, sets mutual_book_live, and spends two minutes; record custody gates the strong refusal ending.

branches.actor_intent: Make the first cause audible before management can begin with labor delay.
state_basis: Miri can read received notices over the local work channel.
reviewed_consequences: Raises default_evidence, worker_cohesion, and supervisor pressure while spending time; later prose and refusal outcomes read the stronger chain.

branches.actor_intent: Keep the shift window alive through Kara's proposed senior settlement priority.
state_basis: The instruction is waiting in Miri's kiosk queue before Kara arrives.
reviewed_consequences: Raises certificate margin and queue time while lowering claims custody and supervisor pressure; later callbacks show junior claims losing position.

branches.actor_intent: Release production under senior hazard priority to restore settlement.
state_basis: Miri owns local authentication but not worker consent.
reviewed_consequences: Routes to certificate_holds only with sufficient certificate, body, and clock margin; otherwise the attempted cycle compounds failure.

branches.actor_intent: Refuse production and preserve lease default before labor refusal.
state_basis: Miri can refuse local authentication and seal records she actually holds.
reviewed_consequences: Routes to default_chain_preserved only with enough evidence and distributed custody; otherwise refusal remains materially correct but narratively vulnerable.

branches.actor_intent: Authorize safety-only maintenance while households move immediate necessities outside frozen ramp priority.
state_basis: Safety maintenance, production authentication, crew consent, and household custody remain separate authorities.
reviewed_consequences: Routes to a bounded household bridge only with live local books, cross-category cohesion, and body margin; otherwise the effort preserves less than the habitat needs.

automated: Ink variable changes for local playthrough state
manual_review_required: Any durable memory or relationship update for Miri, Oru, Sef, or Kara
Any promotion of a branch outcome into Pallas history
Any universal economy schema for claimshares
Any claim that household books have standing outside their local ramp

audit.reviewer: Codex Ledger elaborator using the four required reviewer prompts

review_passes.detected_tonal_mode: Dry workplace comedy with domestic warmth under administrative dread.
acceptance_notes: The ordinary queue, cartridge routine, household arithmetic, roles, and local authority limits are established before the lease default.
Each preparation and freeze-response choice changes later prose, a state gate, material margin, custody, or visual modifier; all ten Ink variables are read.

The six endings preserve consequence: production can restore claim value at bodily cost, refusal can lose the account of first cause, and mutual aid can protect people without solving the missing import.

sources_checked.reason_checked: Primary owner of ramps, claimshares, project access, failure allocation, and the authored cascade.
Pallas chronology, mixed supplier ecology, chokepoints, and liability classifications.
Manufactured rotating habitats, certification, imported parts, and divided maintenance responsibility.
Open atmosphere, spoke interfaces, utilities, pressure and thermal chokepoints, and fault propagation.
Employer-bound support interfaces and cross-category recognition pressure.
Cephalopod dry-yard bodies and mobile support rigs.
Distinct engineered-worker provenance and liability category.
Cephalopod maintenance expertise, dry-operation equipment, and service-artery leverage.
Visible harness, cartridge, seal, limiter, and bypass candidates.
Employer-linked rent, oxygen, scrip, and company-town dependency.
Material care, maintenance, exit, and locally defensible institutional harm.

vault_backfill_candidates.candidate_fact: Ramp claimshare value depends on a contract stack whose defaults can cascade through diagnostics, replacement terms, certification, insurance, freight, and local settlement; small household books can preserve necessities while retaining AU debt.
vault_backfill_candidates.artifact_origin: Service Ring Kappa default and household-book branches.
vault_backfill_candidates.why_it_belongs: It makes the existing claimshare abstraction causally usable without turning claimshares into equity or universal currency.
vault_backfill_candidates.how_to_add_without_bloat: Added as one fixture-marked subsection in the owning AU note; scheduler commit remains pending.

acceptance_notes: Claimshares remain explicitly non-equity, project-local priority rather than ownership or portable money.
The exact cast, shift, actuator default, thresholds, and outcomes are identified as fixture-local draft elements.
Separate counterparties make locally defensible moves whose combined cost reaches worker bodies and households before any labor refusal.

major_findings.problem: The repeated multi-angle ring has a detailed textual plan but no rendered plan view or camera-specific 3D blockout.
major_findings.why_it_matters: Image generation cannot reliably preserve manifold topology, crawl-throat positions, sightlines, routes, and body-scale access across eighteen frames from prose alone.
major_findings.evidence: The fixture reuses one room through six camera slots and makes location, reach, exit, and object custody part of branch meaning.
major_findings.fix_direction: Before website rendering, build a durable blockout from the supplied coordinate frame, fixed zones, routes, sightlines, camera slots, and state anchors.

missing_scene_set_needs.problem: A renderer-owned plan view or 3D blockout is absent.
missing_scene_set_needs.why_it_matters: Textual geometry is sufficient for concept review but not high-consistency illustrated replay.
missing_scene_set_needs.evidence: Eighteen scenes revisit the same curved gallery from six camera positions.
missing_scene_set_needs.fix_direction: Lower the declared draft scene set into a camera-specific spatial asset before rendering.

acceptance_notes: A first pass corrected BFL cartridge color, removed extra or wrong per-frame characters, and replaced name-only renderer cues with stable visible descriptions.
All eighteen Ink visual moments map one-to-one to standalone base prompts and an eighteen-prompt BFL manifest.
The current files are accepted as concept-ready collateral; the deferred blockout remains required for high-consistency replay.

review_passes.inferred_layout_summary: Service Ring Kappa is one curved human-height shell gallery. Its outward face contains ribs, manifolds, and Kappa-7/Kappa-8 crawl throats; its inward mesh rail overlooks industrial air and the axial light. The spoke-side gate, kiosk, lockers, support-rig prep route, and transit anchor one end. A glass operations gallery overlooks the full ring and reaches it by a protected badge stair.

diagram_or_visual_plan_needs.reason: Generated multi-angle replay needs a geometry authority stronger than text.
diagram_or_visual_plan_needs.minimum_required_detail: Use the declared coordinate frame, nine fixed zones, four movement routes, three sightlines, six camera slots, and six branch-state anchors.

acceptance_notes: Prose and visual plan preserve one coordinate frame, three distinct exit routes, compatible body reach, and stable locations for every consequential object.
The rig is autonomous mobile work support with visible body-specific affordances, never a tank or containment prop.
Branch state stays visible through cartridge, paper-copy, queue-lane, security, clock, certificate, and household-book anchors.

review_notes: The four reviewer prompts were applied as separate narrative, lore, visual-continuity, and spatial-cohesion passes after drafting.
JSON parsing, source-path existence, visual-cast declarations, prompt counts, unique IDs, variable reads, branch count, ending count, and git diff whitespace checks passed.
Ink syntax was authored from the accepted reference shape. The task forbids installing or running an Ink compiler, so no compiled Ink JSON was produced.
Image generation is deferred by contract; no images were rendered.
